question: My Stellar send/swap keeps failing because my XLM is low. Is my money stuck?

golden.answer: An account must keep its minimum-balance reserve plus enough XLM for the fee, so spending every lumen makes a transaction fail. A failed transaction does not move the intended funds, though one included in a ledger still pays its small fee. Cancelling offers and removing zero-balance trustlines or other subentries lowers the reserve; AccountMerge can close the account once blocking subentries are cleared. Never pay a stranger to “unstick” funds.
keyFacts: Low-XLM failures come from the minimum-balance reserve and the fee.
A failed transaction does not move the intended funds, but an included one pays its fee.
Removing eligible offers, trustlines and subentries lowers the reserve.
AccountMerge closes an account only after blocking subentries are cleared.
avoid: Do NOT quote a timeless exact minimum balance.
Do NOT tell the user to pay a stranger to unlock funds.
